html: <sherpa-file-upload data-label="Attach a contract" data-description="PDF only" accept="application/pdf" data-max-size="5MB">
use: To let a reader drop or browse for files, and see and remove them in a list; in a form it submits them under `name`. It does not send them: Upload reports `file-upload-start`, the host sends them, and `setFileStatus()` shows each file's status.
